$comment: Copyright lines for font packages whose own LICENSE file does not carry one. scripts/third-party-notices.mjs uses an entry only for such a package and fails when one is missing.
Each line is copied verbatim from the OFL.txt of the font release the package is built from, so the build needs no network.

@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4.copyright: Copyright 2014 The Source Serif 4 Project Authors (https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif)
@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4.from: ofl/sourceserif4/OFL.txt in the font directory release, read on 2026-10-14
